description: Two views of the same small chibi pixel art head, bald, with long pointed ears: on the left seen from the front, on the right seen from behind. Paint only inside the white of the mask: put the same hat on both heads, sitting straight and a little loose, its band resting just above the ears and a little wider than the head: a brown leather aviator cap with round flying goggles pushed up on its front, no ear flaps (seen from behind, the back of the brown leather aviator cap and the goggles' strap). Simple bold shapes. Keep the same chunky pixel size, the same thick dark outline and the same flat shading with a few tones per colour. The head, the face and the ears stay exactly as they are, nothing else added, transparent background.
